trigger: Full-data beta=.25 new training seeds1-4 give primary84.0+-6.28%, worst74.67%, failing the predeclared stable-high-performance screen; same under fresh evaluation seeds83.67+-6.50%.

lower-beta.description: Original AS-JEPA objective and architecture at beta=.0625; a simpler retuning control

temporal-noise.description: I03: Markov posterior with unchanged marginal sigma=.1, correct conditional KL, rho=.8

forecast-render.description: I05:50percent causal prior forecasts as renderer conditions

temporal-forecast.description: Factorial combination of I03 and I05 with no additional model parameters

matching.data: Same full dataset, heldout split and sampler seed/order for each paired training seed.
matching.model: All trainable tensors, initial values and parameter count must match the original AS-JEPA. No extra network, batch statistic loss, BatchNorm or initialization calibration.
matching.optimizer: Same AdamW groups, initial learning rates, clipping, BF16, batch128, and124910-step schedule.
matching.randomness: Posterior and renderer random draws retain the original order; extra forecast dropout/masks use a separate restored RNG stream. Disabled extension is bitwise equal to original loss and gradients in the CPU control.
matching.cost: Report actual GPU-time; forecast prior unrolling adds compute. No equal-compute superiority claim from equal update counts.

selection.prespecified_primary: Four matched training seeds, preserve all failures. Compare per-seed P0 means, across-seed SD/min, noisy-posterior audits, generation and counterfactuals.
selection.stable_approx85: Mean>=85%, worst>=80%, SD<=5pp across new training seeds, no numerical/collapse failure; confirmation must agree qualitatively.
selection.stable_near89: Mean>=88%, worst>=85%, SD<=3pp; report all fresh-case results rather than selecting favorable evaluation seeds.
selection.heldout_training_replication: If a candidate improves or stabilizes the matched four-seed results, choose at most one simple winner and test prespecified new training seeds5/6, with fresh planning seeds2042/2043/2044. No fine-tuning after seeing their outcomes.
selection.if_no_candidate: Inspect per-case dynamics/control errors before designing another intervention; no automatic broad hyperparameter grid.

early_stopping.smoke: All four variants must pass200 real GPU steps and initial-state identity checks before any full variant launches.
early_stopping.numerics: Existing trainer checks finite loss each batch; stop failures, preserve outputs, diagnose before any retry.
early_stopping.collapse: Only persistent zero activity for>=11000 consecutive updates plus two independent noisy-posterior audits failing; do not cull a finite nonempty seed merely for weak early planning.
early_stopping.budget: Stop exactly at37473 updates; no automatic10epoch/20epoch extension. Do not run old held grids.

publication: Commit and push useful new positive and negative conclusions with full per-case numerical results and PNG/SVG scientific figures. Experimental code/configs are committed and frozen before launching.
limitations: No promise of a superior algorithm in advance; distinguish empirical improvement, seed stability, mechanistic hypotheses and novelty.

operational_planning_smoke.interpretation: Execution/loading check only, score not scientific evidence. Must exit0 before full training gate.
